_meta.description: Sample return/refund/replacement policy knowledge base for the e-commerce support agent demo.

policies.title: Return window
policies.content: Items can be returned within 15 days of the delivery date, provided they are unused and in original packaging. Items marked 'final sale' cannot be returned.

policies.title: Refund process
policies.content: Approved returns are refunded to the original payment method within 5-7 business days after the returned item is received and inspected at our warehouse.

policies.title: Replacement process
policies.content: Customers may request a replacement instead of a refund for defective or incorrect items, subject to stock availability. Replacements ship within 2 business days of the return being received.

policies.title: Non-returnable exceptions
policies.content: Perishable goods, gift cards, personal care items, and items marked 'final sale' are not eligible for return, refund, or replacement.

policies.title: Damaged or defective items
policies.content: Damaged or defective items can be reported within 30 days of delivery for a free replacement or full refund, regardless of the standard 15-day return window.

policies.title: Return shipping cost
policies.content: Return shipping is free for defective or incorrect items. For change-of-mind returns, a flat $5.99 return shipping fee is deducted from the refund.
